# opalstack_site (Resource)

A site: a set of domains whose requests are routed to apps. Everything about a site changes in place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opalstack_ip" "v4" {
  server_id = data.opalstack_server.web.id
}

resource "opalstack_site" "blog" {
  name       = "blog"
  domain_ids = [opalstack_domain.www.id]
  ip4_id     = data.opalstack_ip.v4.id

  routes = [
    { app_id = opalstack_app.blog.id },
    { app_id = opalstack_app.static.id, uri = "/assets/" },
  ]

  generate_le = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_ids` (Set of String) UUIDs of the domains the site answers for.
- `name` (String) Name of the site: lowercase letters, digits, `_` and `-`.
- `routes` (Attributes Set) Which app answers which path. The whole set is sent on every change. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--routes))

### Optional

- `cert_id` (String) UUID of the certificate the site serves.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the site is switched off. A disabled site serves nothing.
- `generate_le` (Boolean) Whether a Let's Encrypt certificate is requested for the site.
- `ip4_id` (String) UUID of the IPv4 address the site listens on. See the `opalstack_ip` data source. A site needs `ip4_id`, `ip6_id` or both.
- `ip6_id` (String) UUID of the IPv6 address the site listens on.
- `primary_domain_id` (String) UUID of the domain the others redirect to, when `redirect` is on.
- `redirect` (Boolean) Whether the other domains redirect to the primary one.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the site.
- `server_id` (String) UUID of the server the site is served from.

<a id="nestedatt--routes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `routes`

Required:

- `app_id` (String) UUID of the app.

Optional:

- `uri` (String) Path prefix the app answers, starting and ending with `/`. Defaults to `/`.


<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import opalstack_site.blog blog
# or by UUID
terraform import opalstack_site.blog 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
